goal: Determine the most interoperable way for SwarmBrain to add a bounded multi-agent project orchestrator while preserving existing A2A receipts and task history.

packets.objective: Analyze existing Mesh/peer_control interfaces and receipt schema
packets.expected_output: Interface inventory with receipt fields, task ID stability guarantees and history retention points
packets.verification_requirement: Independent review of interface list against peer_control.py and mesh.py

packets.objective: Design bounded orchestrator contract project/packet schema
packets.expected_output: project {id, goal, packets[]} and packet {id, objective, required_capabilities[], depends_on[], expected_output, verify} JSON schema
packets.verification_requirement: Schema validates against existing task receipt shape

packets.objective: Map A0 controller loop steps to SwarmBrain Mesh.route and peer_control calls
packets.expected_output: Mapping table A0 step -> Mesh/peer_control primitive with isolation notes
packets.verification_requirement: Cross-check with Mesh.route() signature and peer_control call bounds

packets.objective: Assess preservation strategy for task history and receipts
packets.expected_output: Preservation plan for A2A receipts, task IDs and historical graph with zero rewrite
